# Interactive ARC Streams

2. Inspect each supplied demonstration carefully. Compare exact input/output dimensions and determine a mapping that accounts for every output cell. Use this class-level workflow when an interactive ARC submission is marked incorrect and the task remains active. Each turn permits one action and each demo or wrong submission costs points, so a retry must be based on meaningful evidence rather than output tinkering.
